stronger_arguments.description: Soft-close recommendation for the c7/c8 carry-over 'epistemic parity' preemption. c8 recommended a single-sentence explicit-framing addition. Reviewing the current Third argument text ('A gear-driven defense must reproduce the full Doodson family — not just N2 — from a single cam profile. Doing so without an eccentricity-equivalent parameter would require multiple additional cam degrees of freedom, multiplying rather than reducing the model's structural debt'): this IS the epistemic-parity argument at the argumentative level (the ask that a single mechanism-parameter yield N2+L2+2N2 at their observed ratios). What's missing is only the explicit meta-framing sentence. That is stylistic, not structural. Recommend the decider close this stronger_argument as substantively covered by EXP-633 integration + subsequent patches; if the operator still wants explicit meta-framing, a one-sentence EXP is fine, but it should not remain a persistent open follow-up.

kernel_of_truth.description: N2 is a genuine spectral peak of the semi-diurnal tide with period 12.6583 h (data/wins.json:051.detail_evidence). This is uncontroversial and confirmed by every long-record tide-gauge harmonic analysis (Schureman 1958; NOAA CO-OPS 37-constituent list, referenced in the same field). The dome correctly identifies the observation and correctly pairs it with the moon (data/wins.json:051.detail_claim).
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Matching a tabulated period at 12.66 h is zero-cost (data/wins.json:051.detail_verdict_text — 'tabulated since 1921'). The load-bearing physical fact is that the amplitude ratio N2/M2 ≈ 0.19 encodes lunar eccentricity via the leading-order (7/2)·e relation (data/wins.json:051.detail_evidence, hyperlinked Doodson 1921 doi 10.1098/rspa.1921.0088). The dome produces neither an eccentricity parameter (live re-verified 2026-07-18: 0 hits N2/eccentric/elliptic in monitor.py; 1 elliptic hit in formulas.json is disc-geometry FORM-139, not tidal; 16 elliptic hits in predictions.json all non-tidal) nor a mechanism substitute that reproduces companion ratios L2/M2 ≈ 0.028 and 2N2/M2 ≈ 0.025 from the same single parameter. Labeling the constituent 'lunar elliptic semi-diurnal' without any lunar elliptic geometry is the self-contradiction the verdict names.

advocate_mode.best_defense: A dome defender could argue that our own text, by dating the parenthetical '(139 formula entries as of 2026-07-12)', acknowledges the target is a moving one — the dome repo is under active development, and using a snapshot count as evidence of what the dome does or does not contain is stale-by-construction. If the dome later ships an N2 hook (unlikely but possible: Author Contact Status 2026-04-27 confirms author reactivity), our text would need re-patching to preserve credibility. The defense argues: rely on the load-bearing structural claim (no eccentricity parameter, no companion-family derivation) rather than on point-in-time file counts.
